Sunrise Valley

Villa in Cherng Talay
HomeNew ProjectsSunrise Valley

Marketing images, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.

Project overview

A small gated enclave of private-pool villas in the Cherng Talay area close to Bang Tao and Laguna. Layouts range from two-bedroom Palas to larger Grande villas, with indoor-outdoor living and design customisation during build.
